ui.description: The large heading at the very top of the homepage. Use a newline to create a line break.
The sentence below the main heading. Describes what the site offers and who Corinne is.
Text on the orange button in the hero section (e.g. "Explore the Shop").
Text on the outline button next to the primary CTA (e.g. "Watch Tutorials").
Optional hero background image. Currently not displayed but available for future use.
Section heading above the thumbnail grid (e.g. "Latest").
Link text on the right side (e.g. "View all").
The heading above the featured product cards (e.g. "Featured Artworks").
Short description below the heading in the featured products area.
The "View All" link text on the right side of the featured section header.
Small badge shown above the artist heading (e.g. "Author & Illustrator").
The artist banner heading (e.g. "Meet Corinne").
A short bio paragraph introducing the artist. Shown next to the portrait image.
Text on the button in the artist banner (e.g. "Read My Story"). Links to the About page.
The portrait photo shown in the artist banner section on the homepage.
The heading above the tutorial preview cards (e.g. "Learn Digital Painting").
Short description of tutorial topics, shown below the tutorials heading.
The "Browse All" link text on the right side of the tutorials section header.
The heading in the dark promo band at the bottom of the homepage.
Short description line below the promo heading.
Text on the orange button (e.g. "Order Now").
Relative URL the button links to (e.g. "/shop/1").
The main heading on the About page (e.g. "About Corinne").
The photo shown on the left side of the About page. Upload a square or portrait-oriented image.
The bold introductory sentence at the top of the bio section. Keep it to 1-2 sentences.
The first body paragraph. Talks about what Corinne offers, tutorials, and YouTube.
The second body paragraph. Mentions Lheeloo & Luna, specialties, and the Blade & Quill mission.
First skill shown in the three-column grid (e.g. "Krita & Digital Painting").
Middle skill in the three-column grid (e.g. "Character Design").
Third skill in the three-column grid (e.g. "Color Theory").
Text on the orange button at the bottom of the About page (e.g. "Get in Touch").
Where the primary CTA navigates to (e.g. "/contact").
Text on the outline button at the bottom of the About page (e.g. "View Gallery").
Where the secondary CTA navigates to (e.g. "/gallery").
The main heading on the Contact page (e.g. "Get in Touch").
The introductory text below the heading, before the contact form.
Shown publicly on the Contact page. Use a safe inbox, not a personal address.
General location shown on the Contact page (e.g. "Des Moines, IA").
The main heading on the Shop page (e.g. "Shop"). Products are loaded from the database.
The introductory text below the heading on the Shop page.
Heading shown when no products match the filter (e.g. "No products found").
Supporting text shown when no products are available.
The main heading on the Gallery page (e.g. "Gallery"). Images are loaded from the database.
Introductory text below the heading. Mention your art style or invite visitors to click images.
Heading shown when the gallery has no images (e.g. "Gallery is empty").
Supporting text shown when the gallery is empty.
The main heading on the Tutorials page (e.g. "Tutorials").
Introductory text below the heading. Describe what kinds of tutorials are available.
Text on the red YouTube button at the top of the page (e.g. "Subscribe on YouTube").
The full YouTube channel URL. Used for the Subscribe button and empty-state links.
Heading shown when no tutorials match the filter (e.g. "No tutorials found").
Supporting text shown when no tutorials are available.
The main heading on the Downloads page (e.g. "Free Resources").
Introductory text below the heading. Describe what free resources are available.
Heading shown when no downloads are available (e.g. "Free resources coming soon!").
Supporting text shown when no downloads are available.
The post headline. Shows in the blog list and at the top of the post.
A 1-2 sentence summary shown on blog list cards.
Featured image shown at the top of the post and on list cards.
Controls sort order on the blog list. Newest posts appear first.
Topic tags for filtering (e.g. 'Krita', 'Behind the Scenes').
The full post content. Supports headings, images, links, and embeds.
The page title. Used in the browser tab and as a default heading.
Large heading text for this hero section.
Supporting text shown below the heading.
Optional background image behind the hero.
Text on the call-to-action button (e.g. "Get Started").
Relative URL the button links to (e.g. "/shop").
Optional heading above the text content.
Rich text content. Supports headings, bold, links, images, and more.
Optional heading above the image grid.
Bold heading for the call-to-action strip.
Supporting line below the heading.
Relative URL (e.g. "/shop").
Choose "dark" for a dark background with white text, or "light" for the default.
Optional heading above the video.
Full YouTube video URL (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123). The embed ID is extracted automatically.
Optional heading above the feature cards.
Lucide icon name (e.g. "Brush", "Star", "BookOpen"). Leave blank for no icon.
